name: cavemio-swipe-actions
title: Swipe actions
description: A list row that slides over its actions: cells grow with your finger, a full swipe runs the first one, and the row folds away.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The icon buttons are the accessible actions: they are real buttons in the tab order, shown on hover or focus, with the action as their name. The swipe cells repeat them for pointers and are hidden from assistive technology.
- Results are announced in a status region: done, or failed with an invitation to try again. Escape closes an open row.
- Only one row is open at a time, as in mail apps. A tap on an open row closes it instead of following whatever is under it, and a click that ends a drag is swallowed.
- Drags and trackpad swipes write transforms only, and one frame loop runs the spring and the arming, then sleeps. Each cell is a full-height layer moved by transform, so revealing never changes layout.
- Reduced motion turns springs, folds and the shake into immediate changes; the colours, labels and announcements still say what happened.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label
props.description: – · Names the row for screen readers and in announcements, e.g. the subject.

props.name: leading
props.description: – · Under the left edge, revealed by swiping right. The first runs on a full swipe.

props.name: trailing
props.description: – · Under the right edge, listed from the edge inward. The first runs on a full swipe.

props.name: SwipeAction
props.type: { id, label, icon, tone?, removes?, onAction }
props.description: – · tone is "neutral" (muted), "primary" or "destructive". removes slides the row off and folds it away; onAction may return a promise and throw to undo that.

props.name: meta
props.description: – · At the row's end, e.g. the time. Gives way to the action icons on hover.

props.name: enter
props.description: false · Unfold on mount, for a row put back by an undo.

props.name: divider
props.description: true · A thin line under the row that folds away with it. Clip the last one with -mb-px on the list.

props.name: disabled
props.description: false · No gestures and no actions.

useCases.title: Email and inbox lists
useCases.description: Swipe to archive, delete or mark as read.

useCases.title: Task and to-do lists
useCases.description: Complete or snooze a task with a swipe.

useCases.title: Order and ticket queues
useCases.description: Handle many items quickly on a phone.

features.title: Actions that grow with your finger
features.description: The cells under the edge share the space the row uncovers, and each icon scales in once there is room.

features.title: A full swipe runs the first action
features.description: Keep going past most of the row and the first action arms, taking the whole space. Letting go runs it.

features.title: Trackpads work too
features.description: A two-finger swipe on a trackpad drives the row in the same way.

features.title: Removal that can fail
features.description: A removing action slides the row off and folds it away. If it fails, the row comes back, shakes and reads Failed.

features.title: Buttons for a mouse
features.description: With a fine pointer, hovering or focusing the row shows the same actions as icon buttons. This is the accessible path.

features.title: One row open at a time
features.description: Opening one row closes the other, and a tap on an open row closes it.

states.title: reveal
states.description: After 7px of mostly horizontal movement the row follows the pointer on one transform; vertical movement is left to the page. The cells under that edge share the uncovered space equally, and each icon scales from 0.72 and fades in as its cell passes about 50px.

states.title: open
states.description: Released past half the rail (76px per action), or flicked outward faster than 0.45px/ms, the row springs open; otherwise it springs closed. Tapping the row, pointing anywhere else, Escape or opening another row closes it.

states.title: arm
states.description: Past 62% of the row the first action takes over the whole space in about 60ms and its icon rides the row's edge, with a 6ms vibration on phones. Coming back 24px disarms it. Releasing while armed runs it.

states.title: remove
states.description: An action with removes slides the row off (critically damped) and folds its height in 380ms before onAction settles. If onAction throws, the row unfolds, springs back, shakes and its time reads Failed for 2.6s.

states.title: hover
states.description: On devices with a fine pointer, hovering or focusing the row fades the time out and the actions in as 28px icon buttons over a soft edge of the row's own colour.
